profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Grainger | Master's in Computer Science
profile.summary: Professional software engineer specializing in Java and AWS, with 18 years of experience contributing to and leading the software development life-cycle for international projects. Skilled at interpreting client requirements to define technical specifications for new features and applications. Excellent programmer producing clean code based on leading-edge frameworks, resulting in robust, flexible, scalable applications. Expert at analyzing and troubleshooting software problems. Excellent DevOps experience with AWS, EKS, Istio, and infrastructure as code.
